notes: Final CI for PR #455 passed WEB-SHARE-001 and later failed the unrelated authenticated navigation stress with 901 paged reads against the unchanged 900-read budget. Its report attributed all 901 reads to the stress stage because one request initiated by the preceding route matrix arrived after the immediate baseline sample.

The runner now requires the paged-read counter to remain unchanged for one second before recording the stress baseline. The barrier is bounded to five seconds and fails closed if reads do not quiesce; it does not increase the 900-read budget or remove any sequence, cycle, route, console, mutation, network or cleanup assertion.

The mandatory Auth browser contract passed 31 tests, including deterministic late-read and never-quiescent cases. The exact Product SHA built the production Wasm distribution and passed the full hermetic authenticated Chrome journey: six sequences of 50 cycles, 887 stress-phase reads, 892 total reads, zero legacy notification-inbox reads, zero blocked backend mutations, zero unexpected origins, and verified session revocation.
The committed report is a sanitized projection bound by SHA-256 to the ignored raw report. It contains no credentials, tokens, database URLs, absolute paths or screenshots.
Independent review is pending before promotion.
